prompt: Use the provided crop as the reference for the ink-wash shadow pools only, and paint ONE of them again on its own, larger and cleaner: a broad, dark sumi ink-wash pool on warm rice paper, as if a small round bottle had stood on damp paper and its shadow had soaked in. The pool is a wide, flat, irregular oval lying on the ground, darkest in a dense band at its centre, with soft wet bleeding edges and visible paper fibre; on its right-hand side a softer, paler wash rises a little behind, like the shadow falling back. Rich grey to near-black at the core, fading to nothing at the edges, the way the reference pools look. Centred, about three quarters of the frame wide, with clear empty paper all round. Remove the bottle completely: no bottle, no object, no label, no text, no seal, no border. Ink greys only. Plain warm rice paper ground (#F6F3EC), evenly lit.
